name: chemistry loads mhchem with its fixed version and chemfig
code listing and a class diagram load listings and both UML packages in load order
block:
% LaTeX packages from the Examance settings and the exercises
\def\ExamancePackages{%
  \RequirePackage{listings}%
  \RequirePackage{sty/tikz-uml}%
  \RequirePackage{sty/custom-pgf-umlcd}%
}

name: an account entry for mhchem keeps its own version
the account switch loads every subject package
block:
% LaTeX packages from the Examance settings and the exercises
\PassOptionsToPackage{version=4}{mhchem}
\def\ExamancePackages{%
  \RequirePackage{struktex}%
  \RequirePackage{listings}%
  \RequirePackage{svg}%
  \RequirePackage{chemfig}%
  \RequirePackage{circuitikz}%
  \RequirePackage{mhchem}%
  \RequirePackage{sty/tikz-uml}%
  \RequirePackage{sty/custom-pgf-umlcd}%
}
\def\ExamancePackagesAfterHyperref{%
  \RequirePackage{cleveref}%
}
